articles.title: RAF Spy Plane Narrowly Avoids Disaster in 'Most Dangerous' Russian Interception Since 2022
articles.summary: Russian Su-27 and Su-35 fighters intercepted an unarmed RAF surveillance plane over the Black Sea, coming within six metres. The UK called it the most dangerous Russian action since a 2022 missile incident. The crew kept their cool, but the risk of escalation is real.

articles.title: Retired Cop Jailed Over Charlie Kirk Meme Wins $835,000 Free Speech Settlement
articles.summary: Larry Bushart spent 37 days in jail after posting a Facebook meme about Charlie Kirk's death that some feared threatened a local school. The felony charge was dropped, and he sued, winning $835,000. His case tests the limits of free speech in times of high emotion.

articles.title: Fuel Duty Freeze Extended as Iran War Drives Up Prices; Critics Call It a U-Turn
articles.summary: The UK extends the 5p fuel duty cut to year-end, citing the Iran conflict's impact on oil prices. Petrol hit 158.52p/litre. Red diesel for farmers also gets a deeper cut, and HGVs a tax holiday. But the RAC warns of a future 'cliff edge' for drivers.
